Name the three simple permanent tissues of plants.
Which simple tissue gives flexible support to leaf stalks?
questions.a: Collenchyma - living cells with thickened corners that bend without breaking.

questions.q: What makes sclerenchyma stiff and dead at maturity?
questions.a: Its cell walls are thickened with lignin; the dead hard cells give mechanical strength.

concepts.title: Joint Types in the Musculoskeletal System

questions.q: Name the four main types of joints in the human body.
questions.a: Ball and socket, hinge, pivot and fixed (immovable) joints.

questions.q: Which joint lets the arm rotate in all directions?
questions.a: The ball-and-socket joint of the shoulder (and hip).

questions.q: Where are fixed joints found?
questions.a: In the skull - the bony plates meet at immovable joints that protect the brain.
